title: ModelResponseSchema
description: Standardized schema for model evaluation responses saved as data/responses/Q{ID}_{MODEL}.json

question_id.description: Unique identifier for the question (e.g. Q01, Q02)

model.description: Canonical Ollama model tag or name (e.g. phi4-mini-reasoning, deepseek-r1:7b, qwen3:8b)

prompt.description: The input prompt submitted to the model

response.description: The raw text response output by the model

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp when the response was generated
